rationale: The fixed-layer confirmatory none-vs-noise comparison was inconclusive. This bounded follow-up reuses already-generated source embeddings to compare whether codec and channel augmentations are more promising than ambient additive noise. Because the DeepSpeak result was already observed, no result from this follow-up is confirmatory.
target_reuse_warning: DeepSpeak v2 has already been evaluated. These comparisons may explain the failure and generate future hypotheses, but they cannot serve as a new independent validation.

fixed_settings.source_dataset: ASVspoof 2019 LA frozen pilot pool and validation set
fixed_settings.target_dataset: DeepSpeak v2.0 frozen official-test audio manifest
fixed_settings.target_threshold_rule: source-validation EER threshold for each condition and seed

mix: one deterministic family per source clip

interpretation_rule: Report mean target metrics and paired identity-cluster intervals versus none. Even if an interval excludes zero, describe the result as exploratory because the augmentation comparison was chosen after observing DeepSpeak performance.
prohibited_claims: best augmentation selected without seeing the target
